reuse.why: Fintegra goes through the existing findOrCreateBank, syncAccount/handleSyncResponse and the shared BankSyncResponse handling, and the diff folds the per-provider link and download copies into linkBankSyncAccount/finishBankSyncLink and downloadBankSyncTransactions so the new provider is a few lines on top of them.

duplication.why: Five near-identical link functions and two download functions collapse into shared ones, and unlinkAccount's reset becomes clearAccountBankLink reused by the takeover path; the only leftover repetition is each provider's sync-source literal stated both in its link function and again in its refuseIfBankAccountLinked registration.

placement.why: The link-ownership and closed-account queries sit in accounts/link.ts beside findOrCreateBank, the guard wraps handlers where app.ts registers them, and the download code stays in sync.ts.

scope.why: Most of it serves the four steps, but the diff rewrites every existing provider's link and download path, quietly changes Akahu's sync-event tables to include accounts and drops Enable Banking's id guard, which are broader edits than the requests need.

maintainability.why: One link pipeline, one guard wrapper and one generic downloader make adding a provider and changing link rules a single-place edit; the duplicated provider string and the higher-order wrapper's generic plumbing are the only rough edges.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every *-accounts-link registration goes through refuseIfBankAccountLinked; GoCardless keeps its own requisition-based body but finishes through finishBankSyncLink.

disguised_duplication.where: Copies are removed into linkBankSyncAccount, finishBankSyncLink, downloadBankSyncTransactions and clearAccountBankLink rather than renamed; only the provider literal is stated twice per provider.

abstraction_drift.where: refuseIfBankAccountLinked (the shared guard over all link handlers) gains the replaceExistingLink flag via LinkAccountBaseParams and a branch for it in step 4; the closed-account check is a separate helper composed in; no link handler bypasses the guard, and the provider-specific bankId/fileId go in as parameters of linkBankSyncAccount rather than branches inside it.
